Title: Isabella Hammad & Raja Shehadeh: Political Theatre
Teaser: In a land under occupation, authors can bear witness and actors can enter the heart and mind of a territory; but do they foster a spirit of shared resistance? Enter Ghost, Isabella Hammad's latest novel, explores the ties that bind people to their...
Description: In a land under occupation, authors can bear witness and actors can enter the heart and mind of a territory; but do they foster a spirit of shared resistance? Enter Ghost, Isabella Hammad's latest novel, explores the ties that bind people to their homeland as her characters prepare to stage a production of Hamlet in the West Bank. Raja Shehadeh has written several acclaimed books on life and ideas in occupied Palestine. They share their views with Daniel Hahn.

Title: Denise Mina: 15th Century Culture Wars
Teaser: Glaswegian author and presenter Denise Mina joins us to discuss her new novel Three Fires and its protagonist Girolamo Savonarola, a friar in 15th century Florence whose bombastic sermons led to the infamous ‘Bonfire of the Vanities’. Mina’s fresh...
Description:
Glaswegian author and presenter Denise Mina joins us to discuss her new novel Three Fires and its protagonist Girolamo Savonarola, a friar in 15th century Florence whose bombastic sermons led to the infamous ‘Bonfire of the Vanities’. Mina’s fresh take on the story draws uncomfortable and unavoidable parallels between the febrile atmosphere of medieval Italy and modern-day culture wars.

	In conversation with Chris Brookmyre.

Title: Carol Ann Duffy: Politics Politics Politics
Teaser: One of our best loved poets returns with musician John Sampson to discuss Politics, a curated collection of Duffy’s favourite political poems including the titular ‘Politics’, her debut work as Waterstones Poet Laureate that lambasted the MPs'...
Description: One of our best loved poets returns with musician John Sampson to discuss Politics, a curated collection of Duffy’s favourite political poems including the titular ‘Politics’, her debut work as Waterstones Poet Laureate that lambasted the MPs' expenses scandal. This proved to be an early demonstration of her fearlessness. Join Duffy for a fresh perspective on poetry in today’s political landscape.

Title: Don Paterson: A Poet's Life
Teaser: Famous for his poetry, Don Paterson’s new book barely mentions it. Toy Fights is a raw, brutally honest, and painfully funny memoir about his first 20 years, shot through with a passion for music. Paterson explains, this is ‘a book about...
Description: Famous for his poetry, Don Paterson’s new book barely mentions it. Toy Fights is a raw, brutally honest, and painfully funny memoir about his first 20 years, shot through with a passion for music. Paterson explains, this is ‘a book about schizophrenia, hell, money, narcissists, debt and the working class, anger, swearing, drugs, books, football, love’… and bags of Dundonian self-deprecation. He talks with the director of V&A Dundee, Leonie Bell.

Title: Ben Alderson-Day & Sarah Krasnostein: Questions of Belief
Teaser: Do you believe – really believe – in ghosts, or UFOs, angels or the devil? Where do our belief systems come from, and what happens when other people’s experiences or beliefs crash into our own? Join associate professor of Psychology Ben...
Description: Do you believe – really believe – in ghosts, or UFOs, angels or the devil? Where do our belief systems come from, and what happens when other people’s experiences or beliefs crash into our own? Join associate professor of Psychology Ben Alderson-Day as he talks about his book, Presence, alongside author of The Believer, Sarah Krasnostein, exploring how one person’s beliefs can leave another person full of questions. Chaired by Daniel Hahn.

Title: Anne Enright: Flying the Nest
Teaser: Anne Enright, one of Ireland’s most celebrated authors, returns to discuss her new novel, The Wren, The Wren. The possibility of freedom and the pain of separation affect mother and daughter differently when Carmel watches Nell go out into the world....
Description:
Anne Enright, one of Ireland’s most celebrated authors, returns to discuss her new novel, The Wren, The Wren. The possibility of freedom and the pain of separation affect mother and daughter differently when Carmel watches Nell go out into the world. Join Enright for a brilliant meditation on love, inherited trauma, and the types of resilience women must develop to ensure more promising futures.

	In conversation with Caoilinn Hughes.

Title: Tan Twan Eng: Maugham in Dire Straits
Teaser: William Somerset Maugham loved to travel, especially to South-East Asia. In Tan Twan Eng’s third novel, The House of Doors, the celebrated Malaysian author takes readers to colonial 1920s Penang for a thoughtful fictional examination of Somerset...
Description:
William Somerset Maugham loved to travel, especially to South-East Asia. In Tan Twan Eng’s third novel, The House of Doors, the celebrated Malaysian author takes readers to colonial 1920s Penang for a thoughtful fictional examination of Somerset Maugham’s world, in which all is not well. Previously shortlisted for the Booker Prize and a 2023 judge of the International Booker Prize, join Tan for a rich conversation on historical fiction with Stuart Kelly. 

	Please note: Tan Twan Eng will be appearing remotely.

Title: The Big Draw-Off with Rob Biddulph and Nadia Shireen
Teaser: Roll up! Roll up! To the biggest Draw-Off event in the history of the Book Festival, where superstar author-illustrators Rob Biddulph and Nadia Shireen go pencil to pencil in this hilarious interactive event. Come along to hear about their new books...
Description: Roll up! Roll up! To the biggest Draw-Off event in the history of the Book Festival, where superstar author-illustrators Rob Biddulph and Nadia Shireen go pencil to pencil in this hilarious interactive event. Come along to hear about their new books Gigantic and Grimwood: Monster Mayhem and get the chance to choose what both authors draw in the live-drawing showdown. Chaired by Pamela Butchart.

Title: Katherine May: A Natural Harbour
Teaser: Many of us find ourselves in the shadow of the events of the last few years, feeling a little unmoored and wondering: does anybody else feel like this? Overwhelmed and burnt out, Katherine May opens her door and journeys into the natural world in search...
Description: Many of us find ourselves in the shadow of the events of the last few years, feeling a little unmoored and wondering: does anybody else feel like this? Overwhelmed and burnt out, Katherine May opens her door and journeys into the natural world in search of restoration and rest. Taking the reader from ancient woods to sacred wells, Enchantment is an invitation to heal and hope during trying times. In conversation with Sam Baker.

Title: Embrace your Inner Lion with Harry Woodgate
Teaser: Timmy loves to perform… but there’s something holding them back: a gigantic hairy lion! When it’s time for the school play, can Timmy tame their inner lion and shine like the star they really are? Join author–illustrator of Timid, Harry...
Description: Timmy loves to perform… but there’s something holding them back: a gigantic hairy lion! When it’s time for the school play, can Timmy tame their inner lion and shine like the star they really are? Join author–illustrator of Timid, Harry Woodgate, in this fantastic event about overcoming shyness and embracing your inner self. There’ll even be the chance to create your own imaginary animal and make a marvellous mask of your creation.

Title: Rainbow Books: A Storytelling Adventure in Scots and Scottish Gaelic
Teaser: Bestselling Scots translator Matthew Mackie, and award–winning Gaelic singer and poet Marcas Mac an Tuairneir have created a unique storytelling show in Scots and Scottish Gaelic based around their translations of Lawrence Schimel’s acclaimed...
Description: Bestselling Scots translator Matthew Mackie, and award–winning Gaelic singer and poet Marcas Mac an Tuairneir have created a unique storytelling show in Scots and Scottish Gaelic based around their translations of Lawrence Schimel’s acclaimed Rainbow Books. Two adventures await with Guid Morning/Madainn Mhath! and Guid Nicht/Oidhche Mhath! From rumbling tummies and a mischievous cat, to bedtime with a playful puppy. Hear how the stories end in this fun and interactive event. Plus a special appearance from the much-loved Wee Mowdie that wantit tae ken wha keeched on his heid.

Title: Chae Strathie: Spectacular Scotland
Teaser: Bloody battles, magical myths, and gruesome ghosts - Scotland has it all! Chae Strathie’s latest book, Scotland: The People, The Places, The Stories, is a celebration of our country’s rich culture and history, featuring stunning illustrations from...
Description: Bloody battles, magical myths, and gruesome ghosts - Scotland has it all! Chae Strathie’s latest book, Scotland: The People, The Places, The Stories, is a celebration of our country’s rich culture and history, featuring stunning illustrations from six Scottish illustrators. Join Chae as he takes you on a tour of Scotland and discover the secrets that make it so special.

Title: Allen Fatimaharan and Gavin Puckett: Hit the Streets with Blanksy!
Teaser: Join comedy writer Gavin Puckett and World Book Day illustrator Allen Fatimaharan for a spectacular session of art-tastic fun celebrating their new book, Blanksy the Street Cat: a heart-warming story about a cat who uses his creative talents to help his...
Description: Join comedy writer Gavin Puckett and World Book Day illustrator Allen Fatimaharan for a spectacular session of art-tastic fun celebrating their new book, Blanksy the Street Cat: a heart-warming story about a cat who uses his creative talents to help his friend Pete the Busker become rich. But will money really make Pete happy? Come along for hilarious readings and sing–alongs, interactive games, and create your very own Blanksy the Street Cat.

Title: Rainbow Books: A Storytelling Adventure in Scots and Scottish Gaelic
Teaser: Best–selling Scots translator Matthew Mackie, and award–winning Gaelic singer and poet Marcas Mac an Tuairneir have created a unique storytelling show in Scots and Scottish Gaelic based around their translations of Lawrence Schimel’s acclaimed...
Description: Best–selling Scots translator Matthew Mackie, and award–winning Gaelic singer and poet Marcas Mac an Tuairneir have created a unique storytelling show in Scots and Scottish Gaelic based around their translations of Lawrence Schimel’s acclaimed Rainbow Books. Two adventures await with Guid Morning/Madainn Mhath! and Guid Nicht/Oidhche Mhath! From rumbling tummies and a mischievous cat; to bedtime with a playful puppy. Hear how the stories end in this fun and interactive event. Plus a special appearance from the much-loved Wee Mowdie that wantit tae ken wha keeched on his heid.

Title: Yvonne Banham: Uncanny Encounters
Teaser: When Delores Mackenzie is chased home by a restless spirit, she is sent to the mysterious Uncles in Edinburgh's Old Town to learn how to control her unusual ‘gifts’. Yvonne Banham’s debut novel, The Dark and Dangerous Gifts of Delores Mackenzie is...
Description: When Delores Mackenzie is chased home by a restless spirit, she is sent to the mysterious Uncles in Edinburgh's Old Town to learn how to control her unusual ‘gifts’. Yvonne Banham’s debut novel, The Dark and Dangerous Gifts of Delores Mackenzie is a shapeshifting, ghost-filled, paranormal whydunit. Come and discover what inspires Yvonne’s love of fearsome fiction and creepy settings.

Title: Cressida Cowell: Hic Hic Hooray!
Teaser: Join Festival favourite Cressida Cowell to celebrate both 20 years of the worldwide hit How to Train Your Dragon, and an exclusive pre-publication peek at Which Way Round the Galaxy, the next book in her number one bestselling Which Way series. Find out...
Description: Join Festival favourite Cressida Cowell to celebrate both 20 years of the worldwide hit How to Train Your Dragon, and an exclusive pre-publication peek at Which Way Round the Galaxy, the next book in her number one bestselling Which Way series. Find out about brand-new Dragon short story, 'How to Train Your Hogfly', and see her first ever drawing of Hiccup and Toothless. Expect creativity tips, Viking hats and a little bit of magic… Unmissable for new fans and old!

Title: Aisha Bushby: An Awfully Tiny Adventure
Teaser: You don’t have to be big to be brave! Meet a small creature with a big heart in Tiny, the Secret Adventurer. Tiny’s animal neighbours don’t like her because she looks like a human. But, when Frog is in danger, it’s Tiny who comes to the rescue....

But, when Frog is in danger, it’s Tiny who comes to the rescue. Join author Aisha Bushby as she introduces her new heart-warming series about bravery, friendship, and inclusivity.

Title: An Egg-cellent Adventure with Aileen Crossley
Teaser: Henny is a baby chick: she is sweet and fluffy just like her friends. Unlike her friends, Henny has one tiny problem: she’s stuck in her shell! Meet author-illustrator Aileen Crossley to discover how Henny and her friends end up saving the day in...
Description: Henny is a baby chick: she is sweet and fluffy just like her friends. Unlike her friends, Henny has one tiny problem: she’s stuck in her shell! Meet author-illustrator Aileen Crossley to discover how Henny and her friends end up saving the day in Henny is Stuck! – a wonderful tale of friendship, determination, and bravery. Join Aileen to create and draw your own character then take them on a new adventure.

Title: Faces of Inspiration with Nadine Kaadan
Teaser: In Nadine Kaadan's A Child Like You, brave children call out the injustices in our world. From saving the planet to demanding equality, Nadine will show you how to make a positive change. Enjoy a reading from the book and have your voice heard in the...
Description: In Nadine Kaadan's A Child Like You, brave children call out the injustices in our world. From saving the planet to demanding equality, Nadine will show you how to make a positive change. Enjoy a reading from the book and have your voice heard in the Q&A. Then, join Nadine for a live-drawing where you will create your own character – based on someone in the audience!

Title: Malachi McIntosh & Mark Steven: Pen and the Sword
Teaser: Modern struggles have a long literary history. Malachi McIntosh is a professor of World Literature at Oxford, and his forthcoming book focuses on the community of Caribbean artists who revolutionised Black human rights in Britain. McIntosh is joined by...
Description:
Modern struggles have a long literary history. Malachi McIntosh is a professor of World Literature at Oxford, and his forthcoming book focuses on the community of Caribbean artists who revolutionised Black human rights in Britain. McIntosh is joined by Mark Steven, author of Class War: A Literary History, which traces the development of class in Britain, from Haiti’s plantations to Black Lives Matter, through poetry and novels.

	Chaired by Mairi Oliver.

Title: Mark Billingham & Doug Johnstone: Dancing with Death
Teaser: If you like fiction that's fast, fresh, and adrenaline fuelled, Mark Billingham and Doug Johnstone are two of the finest fun-loving crime writers today. Billingham’s The Last Dance introduces a new series set on the mean streets of Blackpool, where DI...
Description: If you like fiction that's fast, fresh, and adrenaline fuelled, Mark Billingham and Doug Johnstone are two of the finest fun-loving crime writers today. Billingham’s The Last Dance introduces a new series set on the mean streets of Blackpool, where DI Declan Miller investigates a double murder in a seaside hotel. Meanwhile Johnstone's The Opposite of Lonely is the fifth in the bestselling series featuring delightfully oddball Edinburgh funeral directors. In conversation with Kezia Dugdale.

Title: Alford Dalrymple Gardner, Howard Gardner & Colin Grant: Beyond Windrush
Teaser: Alford Dalrymple Gardner is one of the few living passengers to have travelled on the Empire Windrush, which sailed from Jamaica to Tilbury Docks. Finding Home: A Windrush Story is his extraordinary memoir, shared alongside his son Howard Gardner. Colin...
Description: Alford Dalrymple Gardner is one of the few living passengers to have travelled on the Empire Windrush, which sailed from Jamaica to Tilbury Docks. Finding Home: A Windrush Story is his extraordinary memoir, shared alongside his son Howard Gardner. Colin Grant's memoir, I'm Black So You Don't Have to Be, explores the Black British experience, told through the lives of eight family members. He joins them in conversation on the 75th Windrush anniversary. Chaired by Lisa Williams.

Title: Weaving Stories from Your Own History with Jasmine Richards
Teaser: Join Jasmine Richards – Future Hero series creator and founder of inclusive fiction studio, Storymix – for a creative writing workshop that’s a blast from your past! Find out about the team of writers involved in creating the Future Hero books,...
Description: Join Jasmine Richards – Future Hero series creator and founder of inclusive fiction studio, Storymix – for a creative writing workshop that’s a blast from your past! Find out about the team of writers involved in creating the Future Hero books, how they used their backgrounds as writing material, and how in your own ancestry there lies stories that have yet to be told.

Title: Make Your Own Merry Mystery with Harry Woodgate
Teaser: Join Harry Woodgate, one of the fabulous authors featured in The Very Merry Murder Club short story collection, in this interactive event where you will build your own mystery! Crafting the detective, villain, and sidekick, together with Harry you’ll...
Description: Join Harry Woodgate, one of the fabulous authors featured in The Very Merry Murder Club short story collection, in this interactive event where you will build your own mystery! Crafting the detective, villain, and sidekick, together with Harry you’ll map out every aspect of the perfect mystery story. Candlesticks and lead pipes not provided.

Title: Authenticity and Diversity in Children’s Books with Nadine Kaadan & Harry Woodgate
Teaser: With an increasing awareness in the books industry on the importance of diversity and inclusivity, publishers are realising the need to broaden representation. Though with this comes issues around authenticity. From cultural appropriation to tokenism,...
Description: With an increasing awareness in the books industry on the importance of diversity and inclusivity, publishers are realising the need to broaden representation. Though with this comes issues around authenticity. From cultural appropriation to tokenism, this talk digs into some of the pitfalls as well as the positives, and explores what we can do to have empowered and authentic representation in children’s books. Chaired by Melanie Ramdarshan.

Title: Finding Beauty in the Everyday with Yuval Zommer
Teaser: From best-selling author and environmentalist Yuval Zommer, The Big Book of Nature Art is packed with easy art activities inspired by nature, using only natural and recycled everyday materials. In this creative workshop, create your own ‘creatures’...
Description: From best-selling author and environmentalist Yuval Zommer, The Big Book of Nature Art is packed with easy art activities inspired by nature, using only natural and recycled everyday materials. In this creative workshop, create your own ‘creatures’ together with Yuval using nature’s treasures such as twigs, leaves, pebbles, and petals together with everyday recycled materials such as paper plates, packaging cardboard, and paper cups.

Title: Natalie Denny: Get Energised and Empowered
Teaser: When the world doesn’t seem right, Keisha Jones will stop at nothing to fix it. Meet author Natalie Denny and her plucky new characters Keisha and the Bee Squad with a reading from Keisha Jones is a Force of Nature, followed by an exploration of...

Then, join in to make placards featuring issues which are important to you.

Title: Sophy Henn’s Got Pizazz

Find out how Sophy creates Pizazz’s amazing world then create your own superhero or baddie, and learn how to draw Pizazz step-by-step.

Title: Comic Creation Chaos with BHP Comics

Title: Workshop: Putting Yourself on the Page with Laura Dockrill
Teaser: 'You are enough. You are interesting. Tell your story. Everybody can write.’ Join Laura Dockrill, celebrated author of You Are a Story, as you learn how creativity can be your most valuable tool in living life your way. Expect self-care, imagination,...
Description: 'You are enough. You are interesting. Tell your story. Everybody can write.’ Join Laura Dockrill, celebrated author of You Are a Story, as you learn how creativity can be your most valuable tool in living life your way. Expect self-care, imagination, and finding the stories that only you can tell. Whether you want to write for yourself or put your work out into the world, writing is for everyone.

Title: Treading Water: Exploring a Post-Apocalyptic Edinburgh with Jaime Huxtable & David Lumsden

Title: Carl Honoré: Slow Travel and Making the Most of Every Step
Teaser: Join Edinburgh-born international bestseller and TED speaker Carl Honoré in this event about appreciating the details of our journeys through the world. The godfather of the Slow Movement, his new book for children, It’s The Journey Not The...

Title: Dig, Dig, Digging with Morag Hood

Title: Reach for the Stars with Sara Boccaccini Meadows

Title: Manga Yōkai and Ghosts Workshop with Chie Kutsuwada
Teaser: Join us for a short introduction to the ghosts and yōkai of Japan, followed by a drawing workshop where you can conjure up your own spirit with manga creator Chie Kutsuwada. Explore the intriguing and unpredictable world of the mystical yōkai and...

Title: Katya Balen: Submerged Secrets

Title: Alex Willmore: I tawt I thaw a Mammoth!

Title: Robin Stevens: Ministry, Mystery, and Murder

Title: Sufiya Ahmed: Cairo Capers
Teaser: Secret agent Rosie Raja is back for a new adventure. This time she’s undercover in the dazzling city of Cairo. Officially she is there to protect Egypt’s precious artefacts from the Nazis. Unofficially, she’s on the hunt for a traitor in the...

Join author Sufiya Ahmed to learn about the real-life female spies who inspired the determined heroine in Rosie Raja: Mission to Cairo.

Title: Aisha Bushby: Bewitched and Bewildered

Title: Janelle McCurdy: Casting Light on Stories

Mia must learn to control her magic before the agents of darkness rise again. Discover how Janelle McCurdy created this magical world and learn how to harness your own superpowers by writing stories inspired by video games, films, and more.

Title: From Tiny Acorns with Lydia Monks
Teaser: Join Lydia Monks, illustrator of classics including What the Ladybird Heard and Princess Mirror-Belle, to discover her gorgeous new story, Adoette, which tells the tale of the life of a tree, from a young sapling to a mighty oak. In this powerful event,...

In this powerful event, you’ll learn what inspired the story of Adoette and see how Lydia creates her beautiful illustrations. Join in yourself to create your own tree-mendous picture.

Title: Mix It Up! with Dr Sai Pathmanathan
Teaser: Take a dollop of science, half a pint of creativity, and a heaped tablespoon of fun – mix them together and you have a very tasty event! Author and scientist Dr Sai Pathmanathan’s latest book, Chews Your Own Tasty Adventure, is ideal for beginner...

Author and scientist Dr Sai Pathmanathan’s latest book, Chews Your Own Tasty Adventure, is ideal for beginner cooks, encouraging them to experiment with recipes from around the world. This interactive workshop lead by Sai will leave you hungry for more!

Title: Twisted Tales with John Chalmers and Sandra Marrs
Teaser: Graphic novel duo John Chalmers & Sandra Marrs (the artists formerly known as Metaphrog!) are on top form with their newest, Scottish-set, graphic novel releases: Harris and Grace, a twisted take on Hansel and Gretel, and Freya, the story of a female...

Join the talented twosome to hear all about their latest books and try your hand at thinking up plots and characters yourself.

Title: David Fenne: Bursting With Emotion
Teaser: Join actor-turned-author David Fenne as he introduces his debut queer magical adventure, Overemotional. Whenever Steven experiences a strong emotion, be that joy or sadness, weird things happen – potentially dangerous things. Recently, when he kissed...

Recently, when he kissed a boy for the first time, the boy’s head literally exploded! Let your imagination run wild as you learn about using role-playing and improv to explore LGBTQ+ characters and themes in YA fantasy. Chaired by William Hussey.

Title: Kiran Millwood Hargrave, Ross Montgomery & Katherine Rundell: Writing for Children - How Dark Can You Go?

Description: If you’re writing for children, you want to make your plot exciting and dramatic – but are there topics which should be avoided? Title: Families of Different Shapes and Sizes with Patrice Lawrence

Title: Flora Fraser: On Flora Macdonald

Title: Eleanor Thom & Wiz Wharton: Family Secrets

Title: Aleksandar Hemon: Man’s Inhumanity to Man
Teaser: He’s already celebrated as a leading international author, with books including The Lazarus Project under his belt, but Aleksandar Hemon’s new novel The World and All That It Holds is surely his most powerful yet. Set in Sarajevo in 1914, it’s an...
Description: He’s already celebrated as a leading international author, with books including The Lazarus Project under his belt, but Aleksandar Hemon’s new novel The World and All That It Holds is surely his most powerful yet. Set in Sarajevo in 1914, it’s an epic journey, an intimate love story, and a portrait of one of humanity’s most cataclysmic periods. Join Hemon today in conversation with Daniel Hahn.

Title: Christopher Miller: Ukraine - Fighting For Its Life
Teaser: The Financial Times' Ukraine correspondent, Christopher Miller, has been embedded in the country for 13 years: he was reporting from the front line in Crimea, and reported from a bombed-out Mariupol. Miller is a leading voice on the conflict, and The...
Description: The Financial Times' Ukraine correspondent, Christopher Miller, has been embedded in the country for 13 years: he was reporting from the front line in Crimea, and reported from a bombed-out Mariupol. Miller is a leading voice on the conflict, and The War Came To Us is his captivating, unforgettable portrait of Ukraine in the past and present, as well its outlook for the future. In conversation with Allan Little.

Title: Secrets, Seaweed, and Scoundrels with Justin Davies
Teaser: Welcome to Haarville – if you've arrived, you've survived. It's a place shrouded in fog and steeped in pungent pongs. Journey with author Justin Davies into the mysterious world of Manx Fearty: a 12 year old orphan about to lose his family’s...
Description: Welcome to Haarville – if you've arrived, you've survived. It's a place shrouded in fog and steeped in pungent pongs. Journey with author Justin Davies into the mysterious world of Manx Fearty: a 12 year old orphan about to lose his family’s perpetual device shop to some sinister newcomers. Learn how to use all your senses to create exciting story settings. There’ll be a chance to devise your very own fishy, sea-weedy menu. Hope you’re feeling hungry!

Title: Kübra Gümüşay & Elif Shafak: How Does the Language We Speak Shape Our Lives?
Teaser: Kübra Gümüsay’s Speaking and Being: How Language Binds and Frees Us explores how language creates our entire world, and how we can expand it. Gümüsay will be joined by novelist and political scientist Elif Shafak – whose work is often...
Description: Kübra Gümüsay’s Speaking and Being: How Language Binds and Frees Us explores how language creates our entire world, and how we can expand it. Gümüsay will be joined by novelist and political scientist Elif Shafak – whose work is often concerned with matters of oppression and suppression – for this nuanced discussion of free speech, chaired by Bidisha Mamata.

Title: Kathryn Scanlan & Michael Winkler: On Form
Teaser: Pain and transformation are at the centre of the two exhilarating novels discussed in today's event. Kathryn Scanlan's Kick the Latch follows the hard daily rhythms of horse trainer Sonia, while Michael Winkler's Grimmish focuses on legendarily tough...
Description: Pain and transformation are at the centre of the two exhilarating novels discussed in today's event. Kathryn Scanlan's Kick the Latch follows the hard daily rhythms of horse trainer Sonia, while Michael Winkler's Grimmish focuses on legendarily tough boxer Joe Grim. How fiction can represent truth is taken to rigorous task in these novels which play with and test conventional form, with mesmerising results. Chaired by Dan Richards.

Title: Amina Cain: The Act of Reading
Teaser: Amina Cain's A Horse at Night has been called 'stunning; unbelievably subtle, precise, and intelligent' by Rebecca Tamás. In her first foray into non-fiction, she moves elegantly through a personal canon of authors including Marguerite Duras, Elena...
Description: Amina Cain's A Horse at Night has been called 'stunning; unbelievably subtle, precise, and intelligent' by Rebecca Tamás. In her first foray into non-fiction, she moves elegantly through a personal canon of authors including Marguerite Duras, Elena Ferrante, and Annie Ernaux to cover topics from coyotes to landscape painting, from female friendships to the politics of excess, while reimagining the diary form. Join Cain today for a captivating conversation with Kim Sherwood.

Title: Blake Morrison & John Niven: Brothers and Sisters
Teaser: Two bestselling authors join us to talk through powerful new memoirs about siblings, secrets, addiction, and grief: Blake Morrison discusses Two Sisters, the story of Morrison’s sister and half-sister, and their struggles with addiction. He's in...
Description:
Two bestselling authors join us to talk through powerful new memoirs about siblings, secrets, addiction, and grief: Blake Morrison discusses Two Sisters, the story of Morrison’s sister and half-sister, and their struggles with addiction. He's in conversation with John Niven, whose O Brother is a blackly comic and heart-breaking examination of the impact of suicide on a family.

	Chaired by Jackie McGlone.

Title: Eliza Clark & Susannah Dickey: Untrue Crime
Teaser: True crime has saturated culture, from podcasts to prestige television. Eliza Clark skewers many of the genre’s exploitative tropes to explore femininity and violence in Penance, her second novel after Boy Parts. Joining Clark is novelist and poet...
Description: True crime has saturated culture, from podcasts to prestige television. Eliza Clark skewers many of the genre’s exploitative tropes to explore femininity and violence in Penance, her second novel after Boy Parts. Joining Clark is novelist and poet Susannah Dickey with Isdal, her thrilling debut poetry collection that explores the ethics of true crime. Join these writers as they discuss their much-anticipated new releases with Anahit Behrooz.

Title: Art Is Everywhere with Joe Haddow & Cecilia Knapp
Teaser: What does art mean to you? Is it painting? Drawing? Writing? Music? Dance? Yes, to all of this? Join Joe Haddow for an interactive whistle stop tour of all things creative. Discover what art really is, why all art matters, and how much joy can be found...
Description: What does art mean to you? Is it painting? Drawing? Writing? Music? Dance? Yes, to all of this? Join Joe Haddow for an interactive whistle stop tour of all things creative. Discover what art really is, why all art matters, and how much joy can be found through being creative. Joe will be joined by poet and novelist Cecilia Knapp, who'll be teaching the audience some rhymes and performing poetry too!

Title: Kamila Shamsie: With Friends Like These
Teaser: Winner of the Women’s Prize in 2018, Kamila Shamsie has become one of the best loved voices in British fiction, while retaining a strong connection with her hometown of Karachi. Her new novel, Best of Friends, charts a lifelong friendship between two...
Description: Winner of the Women’s Prize in 2018, Kamila Shamsie has become one of the best loved voices in British fiction, while retaining a strong connection with her hometown of Karachi. Her new novel, Best of Friends, charts a lifelong friendship between two girls from their early years in 1980s Karachi to professional life in contemporary London. Engaging and thought-provoking, Shamsie's book explores the consequences of acquiring power. In conversation with Chitra Ramaswamy.

Title: Marjorie Lotfi & Dina Nayeri: The Idea of Home
Teaser: Follow two journeys of searching, belonging, and finally coming to rest in this thoughtful conversation. Marjorie Lotfi's debut collection, The Wrong Person to Ask, traces an Iranian childhood through to coming of age in America and a new life in...
Description: Follow two journeys of searching, belonging, and finally coming to rest in this thoughtful conversation. Marjorie Lotfi's debut collection, The Wrong Person to Ask, traces an Iranian childhood through to coming of age in America and a new life in Scotland. Dina Nayeri questions issues around believability and belonging in the supremely personal and profound Who Gets Believed? Chaired by Alex Hyde.

Title: Kirsty Logan, Carrie Marshall & Szilvia Molnar: Tearing It Up
Teaser: Join three writers grappling with power, freedom, and purpose in the minefield of parenting. The Unfamiliar is Kirsty Logan’s raw and moving account of finding her way in queer motherhood, while Carrie Kills a Man documents Carrie Marshall’s...
Description: Join three writers grappling with power, freedom, and purpose in the minefield of parenting. The Unfamiliar is Kirsty Logan’s raw and moving account of finding her way in queer motherhood, while Carrie Kills a Man documents Carrie Marshall’s transition from depressed suburban dad to tattooed transgender rockstar. Finally, Szilvia Molnar’s The Nursery exposes the often contradictory truths of early motherhood; its scraping bodily vulnerability alongside its joyous moments. In conversation with Alex Hyde.

Title: Leila Aboulela & David Diop: In Living Memory
Teaser: David Diop returns with Beyond the Door of No Return, a historical epic set off the coast of Senegal. Drawing on the lyricism of Senegalese oral traditions, Diop recounts an escape from enslavement. Leila Aboulela’s River Spirit takes place a century...
Description:
David Diop returns with Beyond the Door of No Return, a historical epic set off the coast of Senegal. Drawing on the lyricism of Senegalese oral traditions, Diop recounts an escape from enslavement. Leila Aboulela’s River Spirit takes place a century later in 1890s Sudan where a family is caught up in revolutionary struggle. Hear these two writers discuss their own fascinating approaches to historical fiction. 

	Please note: Leila Aboulela is no longer able to appear in this event.

Title: Leyla Josephine & Michael Mullen: Poetry, Formed and Performed
Teaser: Leyla Josephine is a performance poet, theatremaker, screenwriter, and former Edinburgh International Book Festival’s Citizen Writer in Residence. Her debut poetry collection In Public/In Private dances between intimacy and performance, humour and...
Description: Leyla Josephine is a performance poet, theatremaker, screenwriter, and former Edinburgh International Book Festival’s Citizen Writer in Residence. Her debut poetry collection In Public/In Private dances between intimacy and performance, humour and reverence. Joined by Michael Mullen, co-winner of the 2022 Edwin Morgan Poetry Award, both speak about their experience as rising stars in the Scottish poetry scene, and the shifting tectonics of modern performance. Chaired by Sasha de Buyl.

Title: Nicole Flattery & Yiyun Li: Stories Within Stories
Teaser: Join two bold novelists for an exploration into art, memory, and the specific nature of adolescent friendship. ‘There’s just something about two people who are so close to each other their contours press into each other...,’ says the novelist...
Description: Join two bold novelists for an exploration into art, memory, and the specific nature of adolescent friendship. ‘There’s just something about two people who are so close to each other their contours press into each other...,’ says the novelist Yiyun Li. Her latest The Book of Goose follows two teenage peasant girls in post-war France, while Nicole Flattery’s Nothing Special captures the lives of two girls against the surreal backdrop of Andy Warhol’s Factory. Chaired by Lee Randall.

Title: Outriders Europe: Dean Atta & Kostya Tsolakis, Ciarán Hodgers & Victoria McNulty
Teaser: Fresh from their transcontinental travels, four writers offer insights into their journeys – and the effects of migration. Dean Atta, a British poet of Greek Cypriot and Caribbean descent, travelled with poet and journalist Kostya Tsolakis to Athens...
Description: Fresh from their transcontinental travels, four writers offer insights into their journeys – and the effects of migration. Dean Atta, a British poet of Greek Cypriot and Caribbean descent, travelled with poet and journalist Kostya Tsolakis to Athens and Nicosia, while spoken word poet Ciarán Hodgers joined performance poet Victoria McNulty from Glasgow to Gdansk and Krakow, and then from Belfast to Drogheda and Achill Island. Chaired by Outriders project manager Jess Orr.

Title: Outriders Europe: Rawdna Carita Eira & Mara Menzies, Helene Bukowski & Cal Flyn
Teaser: Fresh from their transcontinental journeys together, four writers offer deep insights into traditional cultures, indigenous lives, ‘wilderness’, and more. Storyteller Mara Menzies travelled with playwright Rawdna Carita Eira over Sápmi, the...
Description: Fresh from their transcontinental journeys together, four writers offer deep insights into traditional cultures, indigenous lives, ‘wilderness’, and more. Storyteller Mara Menzies travelled with playwright Rawdna Carita Eira over Sápmi, the cultural region across Scandinavia traditionally inhabited by the Sámi people. Meanwhile Orkney-based writer Cal Flyn hiked into the mountains of Transylvania, braving the extremes with novelist Helene Bukowski. Chaired by Outriders project manager Jess Orr.

Title: Tom Holland: Rome in a Time of Peace
Teaser: Tom Holland is the co-host of the phenomenally popular The Rest is History podcast. An accomplished writer and historian, he returns to the time when Christianity began with Pax — the last volume in a trilogy narrating the story of the Roman Empire....
Description: Tom Holland is the co-host of the phenomenally popular The Rest is History podcast. An accomplished writer and historian, he returns to the time when Christianity began with Pax — the last volume in a trilogy narrating the story of the Roman Empire. Holland focuses on the Pax Romana – a 200-year period of relative peace and prosperity, and shares some pearls from this deep dive into history, with Stuart Kelly.

Title: Devorah Baum & Amy Key: Love’s Illusions
Teaser: What’s the purpose of romantic love? Why do we marry? Devorah Baum and Amy Key wrestle with these questions in their latest books. Baum’s On Marriage is a candid critique and celebration of the many contradictions of matrimony. Key is a poet and...
Description: What’s the purpose of romantic love? Why do we marry? Devorah Baum and Amy Key wrestle with these questions in their latest books. Baum’s On Marriage is a candid critique and celebration of the many contradictions of matrimony. Key is a poet and essayist whose profound and intimate memoir Arrangements in Blue explores the realities of a full life lived in the absence of romantic love. Chaired by Chitra Ramaswamy.

Title: Gina Martin: No Offence, But… - How to Have Difficult Conversations for Meaningful Change
Teaser: Tackling 20 of the most enduring conversation stoppers, the new collection by Gina Martin, No Offence, But… equips readers with the knowledge, tools, and context to respond with confidence. Today two of the book's contributors, Aja Barber and Ben...
Description: Tackling 20 of the most enduring conversation stoppers, the new collection by Gina Martin, No Offence, But… equips readers with the knowledge, tools, and context to respond with confidence. Today two of the book's contributors, Aja Barber and Ben Hurst, join acclaimed gender equality campaigner, speaker, and writer Gina in an event that helps us unpick frustrating phrases, understand why they are harmful, and feel empowered to change the conversation.

Title: John King, Alan Warner & Irvine Welsh: Comedies of No Manners
Teaser: This trio share something in common: their debuts -The Football Factory, Morvern Callar and Trainspotting - were all iconic. During lockdown they joined forces for The Seal Club, a book of three stories featuring characters from their debut novels. It...
Description: This trio share something in common: their debuts -The Football Factory, Morvern Callar and Trainspotting - were all iconic. During lockdown they joined forces for The Seal Club, a book of three stories featuring characters from their debut novels. It was so riotously enjoyable, they’re back with three more doses of comedy in The Seal Club 2: The View From Poacher’s Hill, bringing us fiction that doesn’t give a fig. Chaired by Michael Pedersen.

Title: Sathnam Sanghera: Shining a Spotlight on Empire
Teaser: You've probably heard the word 'Empire' before. The Roman Empire, or maybe from the Star Wars films... But what about the British Empire? Join award-winning journalist and bestselling author of Empireland, Sathnam Sanghera in this accessible and...
Description: You've probably heard the word 'Empire' before. The Roman Empire, or maybe from the Star Wars films... But what about the British Empire? Join award-winning journalist and bestselling author of Empireland, Sathnam Sanghera in this accessible and engaging introduction to the British Empire and it's impact on our lives today, from the words we use to what we eat. Then learn how you can make your voice heard by questioning the world around you.

Title: Skye McKenna: Wild Magic
Teaser: Have you ever been in a forest and wondered if a fairy or goblin could be hiding among the trees? Young witch Cassie Morgan is in training to guard the Hedge, the vast forest that marks the border between England and Faerie. Woodwitch is the anticipated...
Description: Have you ever been in a forest and wondered if a fairy or goblin could be hiding among the trees? Young witch Cassie Morgan is in training to guard the Hedge, the vast forest that marks the border between England and Faerie. Woodwitch is the anticipated sequel to Hedgewitch. Join author Skye McKenna and hear how she loves searching for stories in the wild woods of Scotland.

Title: Thiago de Moraes: Getting Tricky With It!
Teaser: In Old Gods, New Tricks, masters of mischief, Loki, Maui, and the Monkey God join forces on a quest to bring light back to the world. In this interactive event with author-illustrator Thiago de Moraes discover how he draws (quite literally) on lost...
Description: In Old Gods, New Tricks, masters of mischief, Loki, Maui, and the Monkey God join forces on a quest to bring light back to the world. In this interactive event with author-illustrator Thiago de Moraes discover how he draws (quite literally) on lost cultures and ancient legends for his work. And discover a few of Thiago's sketching secrets.

Title: Eat Your Way Around The World with Laura Mucha & Ed Smith
Teaser: What do children in other countries eat for breakfast, lunch, and dinner? And just where does our food come from? Award-winning poet and author, Laura Mucha, and food critic and trained chef, Ed Smith, take you on a tasty tour around the world as they...
Description: What do children in other countries eat for breakfast, lunch, and dinner? And just where does our food come from? Award-winning poet and author, Laura Mucha, and food critic and trained chef, Ed Smith, take you on a tasty tour around the world as they introduce their book, Welcome to our Table: A Celebration of what Children Eat Everywhere. Make a reservation for this five-star event!

Title: Magic Has No Borders for Shreya Ila Anasuya, Nikita Gill & Sangu Mandanna
Teaser: Magic Has No Borders is a stunning anthology of stories from 14 bestselling, award-winning writers from the South Asian diaspora that will surprise, delight, and move you. In this event we are delighted to welcome three of the contributing writers,...
Description: Magic Has No Borders is a stunning anthology of stories from 14 bestselling, award-winning writers from the South Asian diaspora that will surprise, delight, and move you. In this event we are delighted to welcome three of the contributing writers, Nikita Gill, Shreya Ila Anasuya, and Sangu Mandanna to share their stories as well as how this special collection came together. Chaired by Hannah Lavery.

Title: James Catchpole is So Amazing!
Teaser: Joe has one leg and is often told he’s ‘Amazing Joe’ or ‘Poor Joe’, but what if he’d rather just be… Joe? You’re So Amazing asks readers to imagine how it would feel if strangers believed they had to compensate for a person’s...
Description: Joe has one leg and is often told he’s ‘Amazing Joe’ or ‘Poor Joe’, but what if he’d rather just be… Joe? You’re So Amazing asks readers to imagine how it would feel if strangers believed they had to compensate for a person’s disability every time they spoke to them. Join author James Catchpole to find out how Joe was inspired by his own experience, and why he’s so passionate about making sure all children are represented in books.

Title: Creating Magical Worlds with Chris Riddell
Teaser: Join Costa Book Award–winning creator of Goth Girl and former Children's Laureate Chris Riddell in this magic–packed event. Today, Chris shares how he created the fabulous Cloud Horse Chronicles series, before live-drawing some of the mystical...
Description: Join Costa Book Award–winning creator of Goth Girl and former Children's Laureate Chris Riddell in this magic–packed event. Today, Chris shares how he created the fabulous Cloud Horse Chronicles series, before live-drawing some of the mystical characters. Then, discover how Chris puts a new spin onto classic tales as he talks about his reimagining of the iconic The Little Prince story, as well as the wonderful range of poets in his brand new The Big Amazing Poetry Book.

Title: Through the Forest of Memories with Yijing Li
Teaser: Join author-illustrator Yijing Li as she unravels memories from her childhood, including her voyage to the UK. In her beautiful debut book, Through the Forest, Yijing shows the importance of memories in the winding journey of life. Then, you can share...
Description: Join author-illustrator Yijing Li as she unravels memories from her childhood, including her voyage to the UK. In her beautiful debut book, Through the Forest, Yijing shows the importance of memories in the winding journey of life. Then, you can share your own experiences as Yijing leads a creative drawing exercise.

Title: Nick Sheridan: The Case of the Phantom Treasure
Teaser: Come behind the scenes of The Case of the Phantom Treasure with author Nick Sheridan - and help him solve the mystery of the ghoul who has infiltrated his PowerPoint presentation! Become festival Sherlocks and help catch the ghoul using your skills of...
Description: Come behind the scenes of The Case of the Phantom Treasure with author Nick Sheridan - and help him solve the mystery of the ghoul who has infiltrated his PowerPoint presentation! Become festival Sherlocks and help catch the ghoul using your skills of deduction and investigative curiosity to solve the case before it sabotages the event.

Title: What Do You See When You Look at a Tree? With Emma Carlisle
Teaser: What do you see when you look at a tree? Leaves and twigs and branches? Or do you see a real, living thing that moves and breathes and dances? Immerse yourself in nature with author-illustrator Emma Carlisle’s beautiful picture book that encourages us...
Description: What do you see when you look at a tree? Leaves and twigs and branches? Or do you see a real, living thing that moves and breathes and dances? Immerse yourself in nature with author-illustrator Emma Carlisle’s beautiful picture book that encourages us to explore our connection with nature. Then learn how to draw trees yourself before creating your own concertina forest, filled with all different types of trees!

Title: Holey Moley! with Bethan Clarke
Teaser: Gus the Goat loves guessing. And he loves rhyming. So, when he meets Mavis Mole, he can’t help trying to guess where she lives. Is it in a hole? In a bowl? In a sausage roll? Join Holey Moley author Bethan Clarke for a super silly and totally...
Description: Gus the Goat loves guessing. And he loves rhyming. So, when he meets Mavis Mole, he can’t help trying to guess where she lives. Is it in a hole? In a bowl? In a sausage roll? Join Holey Moley author Bethan Clarke for a super silly and totally hole-arious event, with interactive storytelling, a fun guessing game, mole-related crafting, and lots and lots of rhyming.

Title: Discover the Magic of the Ballet with Vivian French
Teaser: Step onstage in front of the bright theatre lights and discover the magic of the ballet with Storyteller Extraordinaire Vivian French. From Swan Lake to the Nutcracker, Vivian breathes new life into stories that have captivated audiences for over a...
Description: Step onstage in front of the bright theatre lights and discover the magic of the ballet with Storyteller Extraordinaire Vivian French. From Swan Lake to the Nutcracker, Vivian breathes new life into stories that have captivated audiences for over a hundred years. Join her to experience The Magic of the Ballet: Seven Classic Stories, an event certain to leave you spellbound.

Title: Let’s Talk About Consent with Alan Bissett, Holly Bourne, Emma Dennis-Edwards & Leyla Josephine
Teaser: Explore the thorny and pertinent issues faced by young people around consent. Hear from Scottish novelist and playwright Alan Bissett about his new book, Lads: A Guide to Respect and Consent; Screenwriter Emma Dennis-Edwards, who has written episodes of...
Description: Explore the thorny and pertinent issues faced by young people around consent. Hear from Scottish novelist and playwright Alan Bissett about his new book, Lads: A Guide to Respect and Consent; Screenwriter Emma Dennis-Edwards, who has written episodes of Casualty, EastEnders, and most recently factual drama Consent, based on hundreds of testimonies of young people; and bestselling author Holly Bourne, who shares exclusive details from her new novel, You Could Be So Pretty. Chaired by poet and performer Leyla Josephine.

Title: Alasdair Beckett-King: Dial M for Montgomery
Teaser: Calling all super-sleuths; there’s been a murder! But don’t worry, famous detective Montgomery Bonbon is on the case. Just so long as no one notices that Montgomery looks suspiciously like a 10 year old girl wearing a hat and fake moustache. Dust...
Description: Calling all super-sleuths; there’s been a murder! But don’t worry, famous detective Montgomery Bonbon is on the case. Just so long as no one notices that Montgomery looks suspiciously like a 10 year old girl wearing a hat and fake moustache. Dust off your deer stalkers and polish your magnifying glasses as you join author Alasdair Beckett-King to solve the case of the Murder at the Museum!

Title: Peter Rabbit™: Head Over Tail
Teaser: Join Peter Rabbit and friends for a mischievous event led by author Rachel Bright and illustrator Nicola Kinnear with their book Head Over Tail inspired by The World of Peter Rabbit. Listen to Peter Rabbit's antics with storytelling from Rachel, live...
Description: Join Peter Rabbit and friends for a mischievous event led by author Rachel Bright and illustrator Nicola Kinnear with their book Head Over Tail inspired by The World of Peter Rabbit. Listen to Peter Rabbit's antics with storytelling from Rachel, live drawing from Nicola, fun games, and more!

Title: Interesting Insects with Elizabeth Laird
Teaser: Two little ants are excited to explore their surroundings. When they end up in a little girl's house, they are fascinated by everything she does: the movement of her pencil and the colours drawn on her paper. Come and discover award-winning author and...
Description: Two little ants are excited to explore their surroundings. When they end up in a little girl's house, they are fascinated by everything she does: the movement of her pencil and the colours drawn on her paper. Come and discover award-winning author and folk-tale aficionado Elizabeth Laird’s Two Ants Puzzled, a charming interpretation of Rumi’s classic tale. Then invent and colour in your own insect character.

Title: Catherine Rayner: Victor, the Wolf with Worries
Teaser: Sometimes we all feel a bit worried and Victor, the Wolf with Worries, is no exception. Victor worries that he isn’t brave enough, isn’t big enough and isn’t fierce enough. But when he shares his worries with his best friend Pablo, Victor starts...
Description: Sometimes we all feel a bit worried and Victor, the Wolf with Worries, is no exception. Victor worries that he isn’t brave enough, isn’t big enough and isn’t fierce enough. But when he shares his worries with his best friend Pablo, Victor starts to feel a little bit better about everything. Join CILIP Kate Greenaway Medal-winner (and Festival favourite!) Catherine Rayner in this reassuring event where you’ll find out all about what helped Victor, and talk about what you might be worried about and what you could do to feel better. Then watch Catherine draw Victor and best pal Pablo.

Title: Annabelle Sami: Beyond Your Wildest Dreams
Teaser: When mysterious Neena introduces Tito to the world of Dreamweaving they spend their nights exploring dreams. But when their classmates start acting strangely, they suspect that someone else is using Dreamweaving to cause chaos. Dreamweavers: Night of...
Description: When mysterious Neena introduces Tito to the world of Dreamweaving they spend their nights exploring dreams. But when their classmates start acting strangely, they suspect that someone else is using Dreamweaving to cause chaos. Dreamweavers: Night of the Scary Fairies is the first of a new series by author Annabelle Sami. Share your funniest dreams, create a wacky fantasy story, and design your very own 'dream base'.

Title: We Love Reading with Laura Baker
Teaser: Join author Laura Baker for a wonderful celebration of reading in all its forms with her fantastic book All the Wonderful Ways to Read. From curling up in a snug nook to dipping into a book on the toilet (!), share a favourite place to read, then join...
Description: Join author Laura Baker for a wonderful celebration of reading in all its forms with her fantastic book All the Wonderful Ways to Read. From curling up in a snug nook to dipping into a book on the toilet (!), share a favourite place to read, then join in with some book yoga poses before designing your own reading den and making your own special bookmark to take home!

Title: Kimberlie Hamilton: Cool Cats
Teaser: Did you know that ancient Egyptians loved cats so much they had special laws to protect them? Or that Isaac Newton's cat helped him develop the theory of gravity? Join author and activist Kimberlie Hamilton as she introduces her latest book, A History...
Description: Did you know that ancient Egyptians loved cats so much they had special laws to protect them? Or that Isaac Newton's cat helped him develop the theory of gravity? Join author and activist Kimberlie Hamilton as she introduces her latest book, A History of the World (According to Cats!) and hear the fascinating ‘tails’ of the world’s feistiest felines in this fur-raising event.

Title: Hello Scottish Birds with Kate McLelland
Teaser: Say hello to Scotland’s most famous feathered friends in this interactive event with author and illustrator Kate McLelland. From the rare swooping osprey to the burrow-digging puffin, budding ornithologists will love learning all about Scotland’s...
Description: Say hello to Scotland’s most famous feathered friends in this interactive event with author and illustrator Kate McLelland. From the rare swooping osprey to the burrow-digging puffin, budding ornithologists will love learning all about Scotland’s different birds in this fun and friendly event. Then, you’ll get a chance to draw alongside Kate as you collaboratively create your own Scottish scene featuring all the birds you’ve learned about.

Title: Thrilling and Killing: Building Suspense with Naomi Gibson & Ravena Guron
Teaser: Join two of the hottest YA thriller authors Naomi Gibson and Ravena Guron as they pull the danger off the page and into the real world. Find out how their schoolyard slashers, Game Over Girl, and This Book Kills, bring the mystery novel structure to a...
Description: Join two of the hottest YA thriller authors Naomi Gibson and Ravena Guron as they pull the danger off the page and into the real world. Find out how their schoolyard slashers, Game Over Girl, and This Book Kills, bring the mystery novel structure to a modern audience, and how even narrators are not all that they seem… Chaired by Sarah Broadley.

Title: Speak Up! With Dapo Adeola & Nathan Bryon
Teaser: Illustrator Dapo Adeola and author Nathan Bryon’s loveable character Rocket has already shared an asteroid shower with her community and helped save the turtles in her grandparents’ Caribbean home. Now, in Speak Up! she’s back to save her local...
Description: Illustrator Dapo Adeola and author Nathan Bryon’s loveable character Rocket has already shared an asteroid shower with her community and helped save the turtles in her grandparents’ Caribbean home. Now, in Speak Up! she’s back to save her local library so that others can read about her heroes such as inspirational Rosa Parks. Hear how Dapo and Nathan created Rocket and what inspired her adventures in this action-packed event about speaking up for what you believe in.

Title: Growing Up Lost In Song with Catriona Child & Emma Grae
Teaser: Join Scottish-born authors of The Tongue She Speaks and Fade Into You as we get sentimental about growing up in Scotland, alternative music of the 90s and early 2000s, and how the culture moulded both them and their novels. Growing up, growing apart,...
Description: Join Scottish-born authors of The Tongue She Speaks and Fade Into You as we get sentimental about growing up in Scotland, alternative music of the 90s and early 2000s, and how the culture moulded both them and their novels. Growing up, growing apart, and growing into yourself, all translated through the personalised soundtrack of our lives: this event guarantees nostalgia and plenty of harmonious laughter. This event will be chaired by Nyla Ahmad.

Title: Robot Boogies with Alan Windram
Teaser: Alan Windram’s amazing Robot is back for his third adventure, One Button Benny and the Dinosaur Dilemma. It’s party time in robot town so Benny and his friends are robot dancing. They bounce and boogie but disaster strikes when they take a tumble...
Description: Alan Windram’s amazing Robot is back for his third adventure, One Button Benny and the Dinosaur Dilemma. It’s party time in robot town so Benny and his friends are robot dancing. They bounce and boogie but disaster strikes when they take a tumble and come face to face with a large dinosaur! Join author Alan Windram and discover what happens to Benny and his pals in this interactive, musical, dance-tastic event.

Title: Journey into Your Imagination with Craigmillar Literacy Trust
Teaser: Do you love getting lost in stories? Then join us on this journey where your imagination is the destination. Katie Swann from Craigmillar Literacy Trust hosts a hands-on event for children and their grown-ups to explore, learn, and get creative...
Description: Do you love getting lost in stories? Then join us on this journey where your imagination is the destination. Katie Swann from Craigmillar Literacy Trust hosts a hands-on event for children and their grown-ups to explore, learn, and get creative together. Get inspired by a selection of gorgeous picture books then make maps of your very own wonderful places using mark-making and collage.
